_authoringNotes: WO-1380 - Echo Guides. THE ECHO DOES NOT FIGHT. IT REMEMBERS.
Source of truth for the fiction: docs/CREATIVE_CANON_ELARION_2026-09-04.md section 7.
Six Echoes x four raid targets = EXACTLY 24 lines. Owner ruling 2026-09-04: ALL 24 SHIP OR
THE FEATURE DOES NOT. A recognition system that fires for two Guides and is silent for four
reads as broken and teaches the player to stop noticing. EchoGuideMemoryRegression counts
them and FAILS below 24.
SCOPE FENCE (owner-ruled, narrative only in V1): a Guide grants NO stat, NO yield and NO
combat effect. There is deliberately no bonus/multiplier/modifier field in this schema, and
EchoGuideMemoryRegression FAILS if one appears here or in the code that reads it.
echoId values are the STABLE roster ids from EchoRosterCatalog.cs (identity lives in that
CODE table, never in JSON). Never rename one - they key the persisted Guide choice.
targetId values are the live scene-config ids (raider_camp_small / fortified_garrison /
mage_enclave / iron_bastion). Verified against scene-configs.json 2026-09-04: all four ids
are present there, iron_bastion carrying sceneName RaidBase_IronBastion. Build Settings
membership for that scene is a ProjectSettings change owned by the raid-escalation lane and
is NOT proven here - if the Bastion is not yet enterable its four lines simply wait, which
is why they ship now rather than re-opening this authoring pass later. The 'aliases' list
lets the lookup resolve a raid scene name as well as an id, so no caller need know which.
Two lines are QUOTED VERBATIM from the creative canon and must not be reworded without a
canon update in the same commit: Corvin at the Forsaken Camp ('Wait. I have walked this
road.' - canon writes the contraction) and Aldwin at the Iron Bastion ('...there's someone
here.'). Aldwin's line deliberately carries NO player name: verified 2026-09-04 that this
game stores no player first name anywhere (see WO-1380 report).
ASCII only. Dual-copy: Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical/ AND
Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical/ must stay byte-identical; Resources wins at runtime.

memories.line: Wait. I have walked this road. It ran to a market once, and it was safe.
The furrows are still under the weeds. Someone sowed this ground, and not long ago.
Road? This was a defensive trench. They filled it in when they stopped being afraid.
These walls are stacked, not laid. Whoever raised them had no mason and no time.
Cold hearths, every one. They banked the coals for morning, and morning did not come.
The old light reached this far once. I can feel exactly where it stopped.
This was the last waypost on my route. I turned back here, every single time.
Grass in the parade ground, knee high. Nothing has drilled here in a long season.
The watch is still set. Nobody ever called them down. Somebody has to call them down.
That gatehouse is Elarion stone. Ours. Someone carried it a very long way.
The forge is cold, but the quench barrel is full. They meant to come back to work.
Elarion held this post once. The Heart does not remember letting it go.
The path here changes while you walk it. I mapped it three times and got three maps.
This growth is wrong. It is remembering being a garden, over and over, badly.
No walls. No gates. They never needed any, and that is what should frighten you.
None of this stone was ever quarried. Something remembered stone, and this came.
There is fire in there with nothing feeding it. Whatever that is, it is not a hearth.
Light, but not the old light. Something in there is wearing it.
There is no road to this place. There has never been a road to this place.
Nothing grows on this ground. Not even the weeds that take everything else.
That curtain wall was built by someone who knew exactly how I would attack it.
I laid the first stones of Elarion. Those are my courses. I never built this.
Someone banks a fire here. Someone eats here. It was lit this morning.
...there's someone here.
